verdict.rationale: Docs claim 'One-click sync with NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero' for transaction/expense export, plus API/webhook capabilities for pulling transaction and expense data, supporting automated accounting sync. However this is only a first-party marketing claim on one product page with no independent corroboration, no details on setup/mapping, and openapi/schema probes for the API 404'd, leaving implementation depth unverified. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the sync working, technical documentation of the accounting-software integration endpoints, and details on sync frequency/error handling.
